name: midterms2026
description: An educational Monte Carlo simulation of the 2026 U.S. midterm elections (Senate, House and governor races) with interactive scenario controls. A Malloy model over a dated snapshot of public data (Wikipedia race map and Sabato ratings, VoteHub polls, FiveThirtyEight pollster grades, The Downballot district results and special elections, MIT Election Lab, Census ACS, FEC fundraising and Kalshi prices), plus an in-package HTML data app that runs the simulation in the browser, and an election-night page comparing the AP count with the frozen forecast, its scenarios and past midterm swings. Not a prediction or an endorsement of any party.
